name: Subhash Silk Mills Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1949, Subhash Silk Mills Ltd
 is engaged in the manufacturing of fabrics and warehousing activities.
keyPoints:
Brand[1]
The company is in the garment industry and regularly supplies garments for Corporates under the name Vastra Creations. The company also supplies school uniforms.
